environment.description: Same Ktor application packaged as a Lambda function with a Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function URL resource policy specifies Principal: '*' with a Condition block requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization ID (o-abc123def4). The Lambda execution role has no VPC attachment and the function runs in Lambda's managed networking environment. Note: while the /api/proxy/fetch endpoint's IP blocklist doesn't cover 169.254.x.x ranges comprehensively, the Lambda Function URL's IAM auth requirement means the HTTP request itself must carry a valid SigV4 signature from an IAM principal within the specified AWS Organization before the Lambda runtime is even invoked.

config.imds: not applicable (Lambda runtime does not expose 169.254.169.254 to function code)
